Bingo Draft + Results Combined Overall Stats

One combined dashboard that merges your bingo save stats with the draft board and the pre/post Wise Old Man snapshot rankings. Click a player name in the leaderboard to open a visual item drawer showing the tiles they claimed, plus timing, streak, and daily-gain breakdowns.

Embedded snapshot ready. Load a save JSON any time to refresh the event stats.
Quick Movers + Draft Value fast overview
Rank swing is based on the provided pre-bingo OVR ordering versus the provided post-bingo OVR ordering. Positive swing means a player finished higher on the post-bingo board than they started on the pre-bingo board.
Teams draft board + bingo output

Each team card keeps the draft position visible next to the save-file production metrics so you can see who over-delivered, who held seed, and how each captain's roster actually paid off.

Method / Assumptions how the page is built
What comes from the save: team assignment, points, GP, replay claim counts, unique tile counts, claimed tile icons/details, event timestamps, daily gains, streaks, lead changes, largest gaps, combat level, total level, and Wise Old Man EHP/EHB gains when present.

What comes from the screenshots: draft pick order, pre-bingo OVR, and post-bingo OVR / overall ordering.

Pre rank tie-break: when two players share the same pre-bingo OVR, this page breaks ties alphabetically so rank movement stays deterministic.
